description: A walkable gallery by NEW YORKERS by MLow: a great New York museum after closing, the night a wrap crew got in and M.Textured every antiquity in the building. intro:
NEW YORKERS by MLow · A walkable museum, after hours

THE WRAPPED WINGThe night the museum got M.Textured. A wrap crew got into a great New York museum after closing and wrapped every antiquity in the building in a painting from the census. You are holding the gun. 8 rooms, one trick in each, and every guard has an eye flower for a head.

8ROOMS0EASTER EGGS11:58 PM TO 3 AM0NEW YORKERS ON THE WALLS

Press F at anything that stands and it takes a painting. The guards only move while you are not looking at them. In the temple the reflecting pool remembers the sphinxes from before tonight. In the court every god is wrapped and one gold star on the floor puts a painting back together across all of them. The audio guide in Arms and Armor lies about every object. The American Wing says DO NOT TOUCH and means it. The gift shop raises the price while you look. On the roof the moon is a building on the skyline and a coin overhead, and a wrapped Hubble points at a studio on the ninth floor. In the lab the gun runs backwards, and one of the originals was never original. The statues are MLow's own M.Texture GLBs, Smithsonian and Three D Scans objects wrapped in his paintings.

SKATE MODE: every room is a skate spot, with three goals in each of the 8 rooms, 24 goals in all. Ride as the crew, the writer, a guard, the night agent, the regular from the roof, the conservator or the cashier. K or the SKATE button switches any time.

Desktop: WASD to walk, mouse to look, F wraps, click anything, V for the vertical clip of any room, M for sound, Z for the telescope, N for a line on the floor to the next door, [ and ] for the previous and next room, R for a random room, or pick one from the list. K to skate. Phone: left thumb walks, right thumb looks, WRAP wraps, tap anything, ROOMS for the list.
finale:
DOWN TO THE STONE

THE WRAPPED WING

8 rooms of a museum after hours, built by NEW YORKERS by MLow. Every statue in it is one of his M.Texture wrapped objects: a Smithsonian or Three D Scans model wrapped in one of his paintings. The census New Yorkers on the walls are real records. The guards were never real. Neither was the audio guide.
